summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MIS Dashboard v2 features: Working Capital endpoint, Center filtering, Export functionality, and Expense Entry sorting/batch features. All 18 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working.

working_capital_endpoint.details: POST /api/mis/working-capital returns cumulative working capital data with daily_sales, daily_expenses, daily_gst, daily_net, and working_capital fields

center_filtering_overview.details: POST /api/mis/overview correctly filters by center parameter - when PB-HSR selected, only PB-HSR data returned

center_filtering_comparison.details: POST /api/mis/center-comparison accepts center filter parameter and returns filtered data

center_dropdown_independent.details: Center dropdown loads from /api/centers independently - 11 centers available, dropdown not affected by filtering

working_capital_tab_ui.details: Working Capital tab displays chart with cumulative trend line, daily sales/expenses bars, and data table showing ₹25.6K total

export_button.details: Export button visible and functional - uses xlsx library to generate Excel with multiple sheets (Summary, Centers, Trends, Expenses, Working Capital, Quarterly)

expense_entry_sorting.details: All 7 column headers sortable: Date, Description, Category, Mode, Amount, Invoice, Bill - clicking toggles asc/desc

add_3_more_entries.details: 'Add 3 More Entries' button creates 3 blank batch entry rows with description, amount, type, mode fields and delete button

save_all_batch.details: 'Save All' button visible for batch entries - saves all valid entries simultaneously

context_for_next_testing_agent: MIS Dashboard v2 features fully working: 1) Working Capital endpoint calculates cumulative (Sales - Expenses - GST) per day, 2) Center dropdown loads independently from /api/centers, 3) All MIS endpoints accept center filter parameter, 4) Export generates Excel with 6 sheets, 5) Expense Entry has 7 sortable columns and batch entry feature. Navigation: Login -> Sales & Cash -> Sales Dashboard -> Expense Entry tab for expense features. MIS Dashboard under Accounts menu.
